messages:
ava: Heads up — RackGoods reported 3 POs rejected by the marketplace portal, says invoices show 'rack-sku-legacy' but PO uses 'rack-sku-v2'. Partner says they can't push new PO before legal signs an amended terms note. Need quick workaround or announcement pause :grimacing:
marketplace-bot: PO 82341 rejected — reason: SKU MISMATCH (rack-sku-legacy != rack-sku-v2). See portal log: https://marketplace.partner/racks/82341
ravi: PO number pls? I can check with finance + procurement portal logs.
ava: PO 82341, 82342, 82343. All three. Timeline: partner needs funds to ship racks next week.
tara: If it's just SKU aliasing we can add a temporary mapping in the PO ingest layer. I'll need the mapping table entries.
jon: Partner is also asking to keep the joint product announcement on Tues — they're prepping press. If ship delays, they'll push back. Can legal expedite?
lena: What's the contract redline? Are we changing billing entity or SKU naming? If it's only SKU aliasing at integration layer, we avoid contract change.
ravi: Portal shows billingEntity on PO = 'RackGoods EMEA' but contract lists 'RackGoods LLC'. That's likely why procurement flagged. Also SKU field made by their ERP sku_transform flag = true.
ava: Partner engineer says their ERP did a catalog migration last month that renamed SKUs. They didn't update marketplace feed because feed SR is in SOW redline review.
tara: Temporary fix plan: (1) add alias mapping rack-sku-v2 -> rack-sku-legacy in ingest (2) accept incoming POs with alias flag set (3) notify finance to reconcile invoices. Anyone object?
lena: We need to ensure this doesn't affect billing reconciliation for customers. Legal approves a limited ingest mapping for 7 days, provided we log source ERP id and partner consent.
jon: :thumbsup: I'll tell partner we can accept shipments if they sign a short consent form. Can we auto-generate consent? Ravi?
ravi: Finance needs partner TAX ID match. If billingEntity different, we need a signed addendum or evidence to route invoices correctly. Small docs ok, but need it by EOD to avoid shipment delay.
marketplace-bot: New task created: #task-5237 marketplace-ingest-alias + assigned tara + due 2024-06-06 17:00 UTC
ava: @lena can legal draft 1-paragraph consent for aliasing? We should avoid full SOW re-sign.
lena: Yes. I'll draft short consent: 'Partner consents to temporary SKU mapping for PO processing through DATE, does not change underlying contract terms.' Send me partner legal name and TAX ID.
ava: Partner legal: RackGoods BV (TAX: NL123456789). They want to avoid RackGoods LLC mention; EMEA entity is correct for EU shipments.
ravi: OK finance: we can pass invoices to EMEA ledger but will need cross-account reconciliation. I'll prepare a memo.
tara: I'll spin up the ingest mapping now. Command: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/ingest/aliases -d '{"from":"rack-sku-v2","to":"rack-sku-legacy","source":"partner:RackGoods BV"}'```
marketplace-bot: Deploy succeeded: ingest-alias v1 -> production, feature flag marketplace.aliasing=true
ava: Can someone confirm PO reprocessing? I want to confirm 82341 goes through.
ravi: Kicking reprocess job now. Job ID rp-20240605-01
marketplace-bot: Reprocess complete: PO 82341 -> Accepted, PO 82342 -> Pending (billingEntity mismatch), PO 82343 -> Accepted
jon: Good news. I'll tell partner they can ship 82341/82343. Need docs on 82342.
ava: Partner legal wants the one-paragraph consent before we accept 82342. @lena can you send?
lena: Consent sent to rackgoods-legal@rackgoods.com. Subject: 'Temporary SKU mapping consent — Redwood Inference'.
ava: Partner signed at 16:22 UTC. Uploading to portal.
ravi: Finance verified TAX ID and match. Reprocessing 82342 now.
marketplace-bot: Reprocess complete: PO 82342 -> Accepted. All three accepted. :tada:
jon: Closing ask — but note: we should add a note to the marketplace onboarding checklist to require 'primary legal entity' field per region. This prevented the last-minute scramble.
tara: I'll file infra checklist PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/402
ava: Thanks all. Can we keep announcement date? Partner insists we don't delay. Legal: any followups?
lena: No further changes needed. We should add an ops playbook entry.
